card.Text: Whenever you are lifting a patient, you should grasp the stretcher or backboard using the {{c1::power grip::name of grip}}.

reason: rule 13 sibling-face giveaway: C#0's visible stem states the indication AND the name ('You use the power grip to get the maximum force... whenever lifting a patient'), so the added indication->name card is answered by recognition; name also self-descriptive. Its power-lift-vs-power-grip Distinguish moved to C#0 (from_idx extended [3,2]).

card.Text: During the body drag from stretcher to hospital bed, you and another EMT {{c1::kneel on the hospital bed::your position}} and drag the patient {{c2::in increments::pacing}} until properly centered.

reason: merged into E_bed_transfers#1; kneel clause deduped to D_reach_pull#1 (see decisions)

card.Text: In a feetfirst backboard or stretcher carry, the provider at the patient's feet must turn and grasp the handles with their {{c1::back::back or front}} to the device, in order to walk forward.

reason: collapsed into F_carries#2 as its c2 (see decisions)
